description: This file defines the FilterFormat class in Drupal, representing a text format configuration entity with methods for managing filters, permissions, and HTML restrictions within the Drupal filtering system.

classes.name: FilterFormat
classes.description: Represents a text format configuration entity in Drupal, managing filters, permissions, and HTML restrictions.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the unique machine name of the filter format.

methods.name: filters
methods.description: Retrieves the filter plugin collection, optionally for a specific instance ID.

methods.name: getPluginCollections
methods.description: Returns plugin collections, specifically the filters.

methods.name: setFilterConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration for a specific filter plugin instance.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the entity to an array, excluding the 'roles' property.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the filter format, with checks for fallback format and cache clearing.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Prepares the entity before saving, sorting filters and setting label.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Performs actions after saving, such as resetting caches and updating role permissions.

methods.name: isFallbackFormat
methods.description: Checks if this format is the fallback format that cannot be disabled.

methods.name: getPermissionName
methods.description: Returns the permission string for using this text format.

methods.name: getFilterTypes
methods.description: Returns the types of enabled filters associated with this format.

methods.name: getHtmlRestrictions
methods.description: Calculates and returns the HTML restrictions based on enabled filters.

methods.name: removeFilter
methods.description: Removes a filter instance by ID.

methods.name: onDependencyRemoval
methods.description: Handles removal of dependencies, cleaning up filters as needed.

methods.name: calculatePluginDependencies
methods.description: Calculates plugin dependencies for configured filters.
